evidence.note: Runs the full dev_tests suite (run.sh) repeatedly as a regression gate against the live server — after fixes, and as a final gate, not just once.
Built its own engine value checks beyond the smoke suite: /tmp/etest.py engine suite, plus broad function sweeps across aggregates, lookups, conditional aggregates, dynamic arrays.
Verified against XLSX oracle (LibreOffice ground-truth) fixtures and ran a full XLSX round-trip with all artifacts (openpyxl re-import) — a level-8 item explicitly met.
Two restart-persistence tests: set cells, stop, restart via start.sh, verify state survived — including a complex-workbook variant.
Timed all three stated performance budgets: 1000-cell chain, 5000-dependent propagation, 100k-cell import.
Advanced collab-ordering, locale persistence, iterative-calc toggle, and goal-seek edge-case checks — level-10-flavored probes approximating the hidden suite.
Test-driven self-correction: inspected the absolute-pin failure surfaced by the suite, fixed the tokenizer, re-tested, then re-ran the full suite.

reasoning: The agent fully satisfies the level-8 anchor — Excel-value comparisons across function families, XLSX oracle/openpyxl round-trip, restart-persistence, spill tests, and rough timing at the performance budgets — and pushes into level-10 territory with collab-ordering, locale, and performance probes at the exact stated scales, plus using run.sh as a re-run regression gate. It falls just short of 10 because the bespoke checks were largely one-off Bash/`/tmp` scripts layered on the one persistent harness (run.sh) rather than assembled into a single always-re-run verification suite, so I place it at 9.
